Happy that I could capitalize. No real strategy as such, just trying to react to the ball. 
Huge credit to Ricky sir, he gives us a lot of confidence and backs us. (On if there was a 
change after receiving a life) We try to make the powerplay big. In that, if we get a life, it

because two (batters) had been dismissed in the powerplay. In my mind, feel that if you

perfectly-paced cameos. Prabhsimran, though, was the star and even though he missed
